summary: Athena Gold Corp filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements (IFRS) for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, including statements of financial position, changes in equity, and property-by-property carrying values (Excelsior Springs, Laird Lake, Forester, Bounty Gold, Mammoth). This is an ordinary quarterly reporting filing by a TSXV-listed gold explorer, mapped to a US domestic quarterly report on Form 10-Q equivalent. It discloses option and NSR arrangements and impairment references but no transaction, tender, activist, or strategic event; no deal terms or board recommendation are stated. No risk-arb angle; watch exploration results and option exercise progress.
